hoy.titular: Correa tears a muscle: out of the Supercopa and a doubt for the final
hoy.resumen: The club confirmed a grade 2 muscle injury in the biceps of Joaquín Correa's right leg, ruling him out of Thursday's Supercopa in Córdoba. Medina hopes to have him back for Palmeiras; meanwhile Supercopa tickets are on sale and coach seats to Montevideo go on sale on Thursday.
puntos: Supercopa v Independiente Rivadavia: Thursday 12/11, 8 pm, Estadio Villagra (Córdoba). Tickets online via Deportick, ARS 65,000 to ARS 140,000, ID required.
Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, on the UNO app): Thursday 12 for members with 400+ points, Friday 13 for the rest, Saturday 14 general sale.
Libertadores final: Saturday 28/11, 5 pm, Estadio Centenario.

linea.texto: The reserves face San Martín (SJ) at the Country Club, looking to close in on the play-offs.
Academy: eight points against Defensa y Justicia, with wins for the U-17s and U-13s.
Medical update: Correa has a grade 2 biceps injury in his right leg, misses the Supercopa and is a doubt for the final.
Supercopa tickets are on sale: online only via Deportick, from ARS 65,000 to ARS 140,000.
The season table is final: Pincha finished 11th and will only play the 2027 Libertadores by winning the final.
